leadText: Snake (Japanese: スネーク Snake) is a character of the day who appeared in Crash! Team Dragon Rampage!. He is a Pokémon poacher who has an interest in capturing wriggly and serpent-like Pokémon. He is a member of Team Wriggle (Japanese: Kunekune-dan, literally Wriggling Gang).
